svg.text: Print the angle clips, angle tees and hinge end clips standing up (Z is the joint line); round 12 mm core

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Angle clip slots 150 deg apart; slot gap 4.5 mm, depth 40 mm, two 7 mm through-pegs per slot at 25 mm either side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hinge end and sleeve clips: ream the 6.5 mm bore after printing

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Remove all support from the tongue windows; the tongue must spring back freely

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: panel edge slides in until it meets the core and both pegs drop into its holes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a firm hand tug does not pull the panel out; the pegs show through both skins
